# KIQA DEV — Kristian Gjergji

> Kristian Gjergji (KIQA DEV) is a self-taught, highly skilled developer based in Kosovo and Lecco, Italy. He builds mobile apps, websites, and web platforms for startups, business owners, and founders.
> Core value proposition: Fixed price, fixed delivery date, zero middlemen, clear communication, and production-grade quality.

## About Kristian
- Experience: 3+ years of professional building, 150k+ lines of code written for live products.
- Languages: Speaks 4 languages (English, Italian, Albanian, German).
- Current role: Co-Founder & Lead Developer at Spindare (Social app launching September 2026), Founder at KIQA DEV.
- Approach: "I'd rather put something real in front of you in two weeks than spend months planning the perfect version. Clean solutions beat clever ones."

## Tech Stack
- Mobile: React Native, Expo, iOS / Android, EAS Build, App Store Deployment
- Frontend: TypeScript, JavaScript, React, Next.js, Tailwind CSS
- Backend & Data: Supabase, PostgreSQL, Node.js, REST APIs, Real-time sync
- Tools: Git, Vercel, Cloudflare, Figma, Stream Chat

## Services & Pricing
1. Mobile App (From €799, 6 weeks): React Native, iOS & Android, Supabase backend, Push notifications, 30-day support, full App Store & Play Store submission.
2. Landing Page (From €299, 7 days): Next.js, 3D visuals & animations, SEO optimized, fast load on all devices, Vercel + Cloudflare deployment.
3. Web Platform (From €1,299, 3 weeks): Next.js, Supabase / PostgreSQL, User accounts, payments, admin dashboards, live data updates.
4. Custom Backend (From €499, 2 weeks): Node.js, PostgreSQL, Login & user management, file storage, live data sync, full documentation.

## The Process
1. We talk: 30-min call to understand needs and timeline.
2. Proposal: Written breakdown of scope, cost, and timeline delivered within 24 hours.
3. Building: Regular updates, early previews, direct communication line.
4. Go Live: Full handover of code, accounts, documentation, plus 30 days of support.

## Selected Work
- Spindare: A mobile social app rewarding daily habits. Hundreds of screens, complex React Native architecture, Clerk auth, Supabase backend.
- TravelMe: AI-powered travel planner mobile app using React Native, OpenAI API, Node.js, MongoDB.
- KIQA DEV (This site): A multilingual (EN, IT, SQ, DE) Next.js web application with 3D elements (Three.js) and Framer Motion animations.
